description: This file defines the 'LiveCommand' interface, which extends 'Command' and 'WithThingId' interfaces, providing methods related to handling live commands in a specific context. It includes a method to create answer builders for commands and specifies generic type parameters for commands and answer builders.

classes.name: LiveCommand
classes.description: An interface representing a handle for live commands, providing methods for building responses and events related to commands.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Returns a builder for constructing responses or events for the command, facilitating asynchronous reply handling.
